title: Automated grounding verification of AI statements about chest radiographs
abstract: arXiv:2604.09537v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A grounding verifier checks a statement about a patient's image against the radiology report and the cited evidence. The state-of-the-art methods for testing these verifiers remove or replace the cited evidence while the patient's report stays unchanged. To our knowledge, no existing method checks both the report and the cited evidence. We present Building Report And Citation Examples (BRACE), an automated framework that builds training examples from public radiology reports and Radiopaedia articles. We compared a lexical baseline and 42 verifiers with 0.1-284B parameters on 5 different public chest radiograph datasets. At a threshold accepting 0.90 of the supported test examples, verifiers trained with BRACE accepted a mean of only 0.239 of AI-written statements contradicted by the report. Verifiers trained without contradicted examples passed the state-of-the-art tests, yet accepted most of these statements (0.830 on average). With

translated_title: 针对胸部X光片AI陈述的自动化接地验证
translated_abstract: 接地验证器根据放射学报告和引用的证据来核查关于患者图像的陈述。目前测试这类验证器的最先进方法是在患者报告保持不变的情况下移除或替换引用的证据。据我们所知，尚无现有方法能同时检查报告和引用证据。我们提出了构建报告与引用示例框架（Building Report And Citation Examples, BRACE），这是一个利用公开放射学报告和Radiopaedia文章自动构建训练示例的框架。我们在5个不同的公开胸部X光片数据集上，将一个词汇基线方法与42个参数量从0.1B到284B不等的验证器进行了比较。在接受0.90支持性测试示例的阈值下，使用BRACE训练的验证器对与报告相矛盾的AI生成陈述的平均接受率仅为0.239。而未使用矛盾示例训练的验证器虽然通过了最先进测试，却接受了大部分此类陈述（平均0.830）。
tldr: 本文提出BRACE自动化框架，通过同时篡改报告和引用证据来构建含矛盾示例的训练数据，使接地验证器能识别出以往最先进测试无法发现的、与报告相矛盾的AI陈述。
en_tdlr: We present BRACE, an automated framework that builds training examples by perturbing both the radiology report and the cited evidence, enabling grounding verifiers to reject AI statements contradicted by the report—statements that pass existing state-of-the-art tests.
